metaDescription: Collaborate with Dzvin on responsible research protocols, cohorts, evaluation and ethical data boundaries.
title: Explore which support approaches may help.
subtitle: We are developing a research collaboration pathway for universities, institutes and programs. Start with a research question, protocol and responsible data access, not unproven prediction claims.
state: R&D is in development. Existing research modules can be reviewed during a technical meeting; each use case and dataset is scoped separately.
capabilities: Cohort comparisons and reproducible study protocols
Evaluation of personal practices with documented outcomes
forecastTitle: Prediction models are a separate development track
forecastBody: QDIP and Future Engine may support future prediction research. We do not present forecast accuracy or intervention effectiveness as established.
steps: Study protocol, available data and pilot scope
privacy: There is no automatic access to private journals, employee information or research cohorts. Every study needs its own legal and ethical basis.
